comment:
* This class represent a rule allowing or disallowing handover between IWLAN and cellular
     * networks.
     *
     * @see CarrierConfigManager#KEY_IWLAN_HANDOVER_POLICY_STRING_ARRAY

variables.name: RULE_TYPE_ALLOWED
variables.comment: Indicating this rule is for allowing handover.

variables.name: RULE_TYPE_DISALLOWED
variables.comment: Indicating this rule is for disallowing handover.

variables.name: sourceAccessNetworks
variables.comment: The applicable source access networks for handover.

variables.name: targetAccessNetworks
variables.comment: The applicable target access networks for handover.

variables.name: networkCapabilities
variables.comment:
* The network capabilities to any of which this handover rule applies.
         * If is empty, then capability is ignored as a rule matcher.

variables.name: isOnlyForRoaming
variables.comment: {@code true} indicates this policy is only applicable when the device is roaming.
